subject: Delivery FAILED - pay $1.99 to release your parcel NOW
body:
Dear customer,

We tryed to deliver your parcel but nobody was home. A small customs fee of $1.99 is required to release it.

Your parcel will be RETURNED TO SENDER in 24 HRS if you do not pay.

DHL Delivery Team

landing.alt: A fake payment page on dhl-parcel-release.xyz asking for card details
